name: Gandhi
q: Freedom is not worth having if it doesn't include mistakes.
The weak can never forgive; forgiveness is strength.
Non-violence is the greatest force available to mankind.
Easier to destroy than to create
A man is but the product of his thoughts.
If a few drops are dirty, the ocean stays clean.
You must never lose faith in humanity.
Where there is love, there is life.
In conscience, majority has no place
Nonviolence is a weapon of the strong
A coward is incapable of exhibiting love; it is the prerogative of the brave
Happiness: thought, word, deed in tune
There is more to life than increasing its speed
Enough for every need, not every greed
Nonviolence is the first article of my faith and the last article of my creed
